- **Reasons:** None of the three has a recorded reason. Indooroopilly and Mt Gravatt already plan just above the peer rate.
- **Company position:** The company plan is AUD 90,323,872, against a board-approved AUD 90,317,702. Hardgoods' gap in the planning chain is AUD -3,783,503.
